test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Neither the doctors nor / the nurse were present / when the patient / reached the hospital.
solution:
The correct answer is **the nurse were present**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Was** should be used instead of **were**.
 
• If a sentence has two subjects connected by **or/nor, either/or, or neither/nor**, the verb must agree with **the second subject **(the subject closer to the verb).
 
 
• *Example: Neither Rohan nor his friends **were **present at the party.*
 
 
 
• The helping verb should agree with the subject '**the nurse' (Singular) **for the given sentence
 
• Therefore, a singular verb** 'was'** should be used instead of the plural verb **'were'**.
 
• Thus, the option that contains a grammatical error is **option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:**__* Neither the doctors nor / __**the nurse was present**__ / when the patient / reached the hospital.*
